stage: NON-CLAIM mechanism probe: read the trained transformer, plus a panel shortcut audit
purpose: aq/w/as/au put the transformer at 0/168 with training loss flat from ~step 270. Nothing in the programme had read the trained model. This does.
source_provenance: training loop reproduced from sealed train.py, which was never modified (train_run does not return the model). data.py/models.py/train.py/cand_variant.py sha256-verified byte-identical to aq before launch.

harness_validation.note: third pair differs within GPU non-determinism; both sit at the 1/16 chance floor

findings.hard_panel_accuracy_distance_independent: pairs80 @3e-4, recall 0.1275: accuracy by distance 8-16:0.125, 16-32:0.000, 32-64:0.047, 64-128:0.127, 128+:0.122. Flat. Not partial retrieval at short range; no effective retrieval reach at all.
findings.easy_panel_control: 48 tokens/8 pairs: 0.4235 @3e-4, 0.4199 @1e-3, 0.1820 @3e-3, chance 0.0625. Distance-structured (0.26 @0-4 -> 0.50 @16-32). The harness CAN produce retrieval; the transformer arm is not broken.
findings.shortfall_vs_literature: 0.42 is well below the near-perfect MQAR accuracy Zoology reports for attention. Most likely cause: the frozen suite's 70/30 MQAR/STATE mixture, under which STATE dominates masked positions and dilutes the retrieval signal. Applies equally to the candidate, which still transitions 6/6, so the comparison stays internally fair.
findings.attention_mass_metric_uninformative: Failing hard-panel model carries 4.0x uniform baseline on max-over-heads mean attention mass at the answer token; SUCCEEDING easy-panel models carry 1.6x and 2.3x. Anti-correlated with capability. Recorded as uninformative as constructed.
findings.panel_shortcut_audit: pairs80, p80x384, seq384, p48x448 all clean: distances vary (2-238, 119 distinct), keys unique, marginal guess ~0.066 vs chance 0.0625, positional guess ~0.085, queries shuffled vs pair order. ar's fixed-offset flaw does not generalise to the panels the sealed claims rest on.

retraction: An earlier reading of these same runs claimed the transformer never forms a retrieval circuit. The attention-mass metric cannot support that claim in either direction; it is withdrawn. The distance-independence result stands.
